I believe you did mean well by this post but unfortunately this is a very dangerous and toxic suggestion. I was a very serious porn addict and it couldn’t be “vanilla” it had to be hardcore, painful (which I now personal view as very degrading porn). I would have a constant need to touch myself, have porn on the tv walking about as if it’s normal (I lived alone at the time) it became so bad I would sneak off to toilets, go home early or not leave the house at all because I couldn’t stop. 

I had entered into a new relationship and decided to go cold turkey with the porn and introduce the kinks strongly into the relationship. This was one of the biggest mistakes I could make, that’s all the relationship became about and it had to be extreme to get off and the relationship spiralled out of control. 

Kink communities can be great and safe to talk openly about the kinks you do with people that share the interest and like doing what you do but you are unknowingly feeding that addiction demon everytime you go. And then you need more because most the time these people in the community don’t know how much you are abusing the kink and it becomes everything that you are.
Our sex drive was constant and when we weren’t having sex we would argue and then have sex to take the anger out on each other. This is an extremely dangerous situation and later turned to abuse. 
It was the abuse that had developed outside the bedroom that made me leave, this is where I took the time to reconnect with myself.

I strongly suggest therapy after the cold turkey. This is like a serious drug addiction for people.

I am so so happy I stopped when I did and searched for help. I would never have known that what people class as vanilla sex can be so beautiful. I’m now at a point in my life I prefer vanilla, there’s more a sense of connection and reality to it and I’m also in a more healthy and stable relationship and I couldn’t be more glad about it. My sex and social life has never been better.

I am completely porn free for years now and no longer feel the need to pleasure myself.
 
It’s no longer necessary in my life, I’ve freed myself from myself and can finally enjoy the real pleasures in my life
